full_prompt_en: A lively eighteenth-century satirical watercolor shows an exuberant gentleman springing away from a stone doorway while two women lean out behind him. He wears an oversized blue top hat and blue coat, an ocher waistcoat, brown breeches, white stockings, and a billowing white neckcloth. His mouth opens in a broad animated expression, one hand flings outward, and his front leg stretches dramatically into the open left side of the picture. The women at the right react with amused surprise, their pale bonnets and soft pink or sage garments emerging from the dark doorway. The setting is only lightly described: a few stone blocks, rough ground, a small patch of pale sky, and faint greenery are enough to place the figures outside. The gentleman's body makes a strong diagonal across the frame, while the two women and doorway create a vertical counterweight. Fine brown ink outlines define noses, fingers, fabric folds, and facial expressions, with quick scratchy hatching under coats and along stone edges. Transparent watercolor washes fill the forms in muted blue, warm ocher, rose, sage, and gray, allowing the cream paper to shine through in highlights. Darker pigment pools at seams and edges, but the open background remains thin and airy. Proportions are deliberately comic, especially the wide gesture, long stride, and lively faces, yet the clothing retains specific period detail. Light is even and natural, with no dramatic shadow beyond the recessed doorway. The image feels spontaneous and theatrical, turning a small social encounter into a buoyant visual joke through gesture and brisk handmade line.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅活泼的十八世纪讽刺水彩表现一名兴奋绅士从石门口跳开，两名女子从后方探身。他戴夸大的蓝色高礼帽，穿蓝外套、赭黄背心、棕马裤、白长袜和鼓起的白领巾。嘴张得很大，一只手向外甩，前腿戏剧性地伸向画面开放的左侧。右侧两名女子带着愉快惊讶反应，浅色软帽与粉或鼠尾草色衣物从暗门口浮出。场所只轻描：几块石头、粗地面、一小块浅天和淡绿植就足以将人放在室外。绅士身体在画幅中形成强对角，两名女子与门口则提供竖向对重。细褐墨轮廓界定鼻、手指、衣褶与表情，迅速刮擦般排线出现在外套下和石边。透明水彩洗色以暗蓝、暖赭、玫瑰、鼠尾草与灰填满形体，奶油纸在高光处透出。深颜料聚在缝与边上，开放背景却薄而透气。比例刻意可笑，尤其是宽手势、长步伐和生动面孔，但衣着仍保留具体时代细节。光均匀自然，除了内凹门口没有戏剧阴影。画面自发而有戏剧感，借手势与迅速手绘线，把小社交事件变成轻快视觉玩笑。
style_prompt_en: Satirical ink-and-watercolor drawing combines fine lively brown contours with thin transparent color washes on visible cream paper. Muted blue, ocher, dusty rose, sage, and warm gray remain light, with darker pigment collecting only along folds and recesses. Quick scratchy hatching animates small edges, while larger areas of sky and ground are barely indicated. The focal form stretches along a long diagonal with exaggerated bends and expressive gestures; a compact vertical cluster at one side balances it. Contours are confident but uneven, allowing spontaneous hand movement to show. The background is sparse and airy, so the action reads immediately without detailed setting. Even daylight and paper-white highlights keep the overall tone buoyant. The visual rhythm is brisk, humorous, and slightly theatrical, built from loose line, transparent color, and deliberately elastic proportions.
style_prompt_zh: 讽刺性墨线水彩以细而活的褐轮廓，结合可见奶油纸上的薄透明洗色。暗蓝、赭、灰玫瑰、鼠尾草与暖灰保持轻浅，深颜料仅聚于褶皱和凹处。迅速刮擦排线让小边缘活跃，大块天和地则几乎只作提示。焦点形体沿长对角伸展，有夸大的弯折与富表情手势；一侧紧凑竖簇予以平衡。轮廓自信却不均，让自发手部运动显露。背景稀疏透气，因此动作不靠详细场所也立即可读。均匀日光和纸白高光保持整体轻快。视觉节奏迅速、幽默且略有舞台感，由松线、透明颜色与刻意弹性的比例建成。
theme_en: An exuberant gentleman in blue steps out as two women react at a doorway
theme_zh: 蓝衣兴奋绅士跨步而出，两名女子在门边作出反应
name: Thomas Rowlandson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
